layout.revealText: Your prediction held.Turning the trefoil over left every mark minus: turning over is a way of moving it, so its hand stayed left. Mirroring turned every mark plus, and no wiggling gets back: the trefoil is not its own mirror image, as Max Dehn proved in 1914.The figure-eight is different: it is its own mirror image. So a trefoil comes in a left and a right version, and turning one over never swaps
